skills.name: Lightning-style (雷霆式)
skills.line: It's time for the heavenly judgement.
skills.description: Susanoo focuses the power of thunder to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Divine Realm (神の領域)
skills.line: Thunder is my body, Storm is my breath, Lighting is my bones.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the start of battle and his turn, Susanoo gains the 6 Divine Swords: Ama no Habakiri. When an Ama no Habakiri is present, other non-summoned allies gain the skill Heavenly Might. When an enemy shikigami receives lethal damage from Susanoo, they will first become suppressed and turned into a Thunder Tomb. ; : ;Thunder Aegis (雷盾) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Absorbs a certain amount of damage and cannot be dispelled. ;Thunder Tomb (雷塚) : :Becomes Immobile and cannot trigger souls or passives. HP is equal to 150% of Susanoo's initial ATK. When Thunder Tomb is KO'd, the suppressed enemy shikigami is revived at 1 HP. If the enemy only has Thunder Tombs on their side, it will be considered a win. This effect can only be inflicted on the same enemy once. :''(Tombs are considered as allies.)''

upgrades.text: '''Heavenly Might''': Damage ignores enemy soul effects.
When using Heavenly Might, Susanoo gains a Thunder Aegis that can absorb damage equal to 49% of his ATK, lasts for 2 turns and has a max of 2 stacks.
If Susanoo is not protected by Thunder Aegis, he is in high spirits, causing Thunder Armageddon's the damage and damage boost limit are increased by an additional 20%.

skills.name: Heavenly Might (天威)
skills.line: Don't try to get your hands on the god's people!
skills.description:
:''Non-summoned allies can use this skill at the start of their turn before using their own skills.''
The spear can pierce the sky and shock the world. Susanoo uses Divine Sword: Ama no Habakiri to attack 1 enemy if he's not Immobile. This attack cannot trigger Assist. The ally cannot deal damage on the turn this skill is used on.
;Upon Usage
:Susanoo consumes 1 Ama no Habakiri to attack 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 211% of his ATK (cannot exceed 400% of the initial ATK for the ally on that turn).
;Assist
:When an ally uses a normal attack to attack an enemy, will also use normal attack to attack the same target.

skills.name: Thunder Armageddon (天雷万象)
skills.line: The gods live above the sky and the sinners are locked away in hell.
skills.description:
Even the crushing force of the thunde3 follows the god's will.
Susanoo focuses the power of thunder and lightning to forge a sky-piercing spear and launches a 6-strike attack on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 60% of his ATK with each strike. If the target has higher max HP then him, each 10% difference increases the damage by 3% (max of 50%).

bio.condition: With Susanoo win 10 times in against SP Orochi.
